name: @kyneloom/moment-compiler
description: The deterministic Playable Moment compiler (KYN-16): validates untrusted MomentProposals against source-derived match truth and compiles trusted, versioned, content-hashed MomentManifests plus their synchronized broadcast-overlay and recap derivations. May depend on @kyneloom/contracts and @kyneloom/match-core; nothing may depend on this package except applications.
